description: Tailings-dam safety per mining company from ANM's SIGBM register: number of dams, dams at an emergency level or at alert, high risk category (CRI) and high associated potential damage (DPA), and the worst emergency level. Use for 'which mining companies have dams in emergency'. Worst first. Needs the mining sector licensed. Deterministic: computed from official datasets, no model in the loop.

entity.description: Optional. One company by name, e.g. 'Vale'.

name: dam_safety
title: Mining dam safety per company (ANM SIGBM)
